errors.evidence: The description states that the unit for the x-axis is 'order of magnitude' (数量级), but the x-axis is labeled '数据量' (data amount) without any specified units.
The description claims that the data points are marked with circles, but there are no visible markers on the data points in the line plot.
The description states the first data point with a ROUGE-2 score of 21.49 is at a data amount of 0. However, the plot shows this point at an x-axis value greater than 0, approximately at 1000.
The description identifies the value 31.55 (at data amount 10000) as the peak ('峰值'). However, this is only a local peak; the overall maximum value on the chart is 33.43 (at data amount 40000).
